# gitea_repository_file (Data Source)

Fetches content and metadata of a single file in a Gitea repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_file" "example" {
  username  = "my-org"
  name      = "my-repo"
  file_path = "README.md"
}
```
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_path` (String) Path to the file relative to repo root
- `name` (String) Repository name
- `username` (String) Owner of the repository

### Optional

- `branch` (String) Branch to read from; default branch if empty

### Read-Only

- `commit_message` (String) Commit message of the last commit that modified this file
- `content` (String) Base64-encoded file content
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp of last commit that modified this file
- `file_sha` (String) File blob SHA
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_commit_sha` (String) Last commit SHA touching the file
- `size` (Number) File size in bytes
